                     Standard Analysis Process
                    
                        News Collection: Fetch latest financial news from multiple sources (Finnhub, Reddit, Yahoo Finance)
                        AI Sentiment Analysis: Use advanced AI models (Ollama, DeepSeek, or OpenAI) for sentiment analysis
                        Sentiment Scoring: Convert news sentiment into quantitative scores (-1 to +1)
                        Signal Generation: Transform sentiment into actionable trading signals
                        Trading Recommendations: Generate optimized options strategies with strike prices and expiry dates
                    
                    
                    
                    
                     Enhanced Analysis Process
                    
                        Multi-Strategy Generation: Create distinct trading strategies (Conservative, Moderate, Income-Focused)
                        Historical Backtesting: Test each strategy against 730 days (2 years) of real market data from Alpha Vantage
                        Performance Validation: Calculate win rates, average returns, and consistency scores for each strategy
                        Advanced Confidence Scoring: Combine sentiment analysis (30%) with historical performance (70%)
                        Strategy Ranking: Rank all strategies by confidence and select the highest-performing approach
                    
                    
                    
                         Free AI: Ollama (local) and DeepSeek are completely FREE!
                    
                    
                    
                         Enhanced Analysis: Uses sophisticated backtesting with 730 days (2 years) of historical data to validate strategies before recommendations. This provides much higher confidence in trade outcomes!

⚠️ Day trading options carries high risk - never risk more than you can afford to lose
📊 Monitor option Greeks: Focus on Delta for directional moves, Theta for time decay
⏰ Time decay accelerates rapidly on 0-2 DTE options
💧 Ensure sufficient liquidity - avoid wide bid-ask spreads
📈 Consider market conditions: trending vs. choppy markets affect success rates
📊 Moderate conviction - wait for technical confirmation

entry_strategy.confirmation: Look for volume spike or technical confirmation
entry_strategy.method: Limit order at mid-price or better
entry_strategy.timing: Wait for 5-15 minute confirmation of price direction
entry_strategy.volume_check: Check option chain liquidity before entry

exit_strategy.market_close: Close all positions 30 minutes before market close
exit_strategy.partial_exits: Consider taking 50% profits at half target, let rest run
exit_strategy.time_stop: Exit before 15-60 minutes regardless of P&L if no momentum
exit_strategy.trailing_stop: Consider trailing stop after 50% of target is reached
